profile.name: Aryan Thind
profile.tagline: I build systems that see the physical world and software that takes care of people.
profile.role: CS Student, Specializing in Machine Learning
profile.bio: I'm a computer science student at the University of Maryland studying machine learning, spending most of my time on two kinds of problems: getting software to understand physical space (AR, computer vision, sensor fusion), and building tools for organizations that need software to just work for real people. Recent work spans a first-responder AR system, an autonomous tracking drone, and the mobile app for a scoliosis nonprofit.
profile.beyondCode: Outside of building things, I've spent time teaching: as a TA for a high school programming lab, and as president of my school's United Sound chapter, playing alongside students with intellectual and developmental disabilities in the concert band.

experience.summary: Designing and building the nonprofit's iOS app pro bono, translating their existing mentor program and educational resources into a moderated mobile platform for kids, parents, and clinicians.
highlights: Built three distinct account modes (kid, parent, clinician) with separate onboarding flows and COPPA-compliant parental consent for users under 13
Designed the full component system in SwiftUI with typography, color tokens, badge pills, card layouts from scratch
Implemented a moderated community forum, profile-based mentor matching, and a recovery timeline that feeds milestones into a shared events calendar

experience.role: Software Engineer, Career Development — Pinterest Engage Program
experience.summary: A selective 4-month program pairing rising engineers with Pinterest SWEs to bridge classroom CS and industry practice.
highlights: Partnered directly with experienced Pinterest engineers on real feature work for a collaborative platform
Learned how a large product team scopes, reviews, and ships design and engineering decisions together
Built technical and interpersonal habits for working on a real team, not just a solo project

experience.summary: Contributed to a student-mentor tutoring platform built for a global MIT alumni-run program.
highlights: Built and styled frontend pages and UI components in HTML/CSS
Developed REST API endpoints in Node.js for backend logic and data flow
Integrated frontend and backend to support smooth student-mentor matching
Iterated on features based on direct user feedback

experience.summary: Supported a teacher and about 26 students in a programming lab, reinforcing core Java concepts.
highlights: Ran small-group discussions for students who preferred working through a concept one-on-one
Reinforced programming fundamentals in Java for students who were stuck
Built the habit of explaining technical ideas without leaning on jargon

projects.title: Scolios-US App
projects.subtitle: Mentor matching & community app for a scoliosis nonprofit
projects.description: An ongoing, unpaid build for Scolios-US: a moderated mobile app connecting young scoliosis patients, their parents, and clinicians through mentor matching, a community forum, and a recovery timeline. I own both the design system and the SwiftUI build, including a COPPA-aware onboarding flow that changes based on account type.

projects.title: WallHax
projects.subtitle: Real-time multi-device AR for first responders
projects.description: 1st place, AI/Data Science track at UVA Hoo Hacks. An iOS app using ARKit and RealityKit to stream live device poses over a network and render teammates as see-through avatars, with on-device LiDAR floor-plan generation and a web viewer for post-incident timeline playback.

projects.title: Gazer
projects.subtitle: Autonomous face-tracking drone for digital forensics
projects.description: A DJI Tello drone driven by a custom PID controller and YOLOv8 Nano for real-time face tracking, built as an unbiased autonomous observer for criminal investigations. Video streaming, flight control, and inference run as concurrent threads, with a Next.js control dashboard for live override.

education.degree: B.S., Computer Science — Specialization in Machine Learning
